pred_interval_order.name: pred_interval_order
pred_interval_order.value: "predictions"."interval_low_pct" is null or "predictions"."interval_high_pct" is null or "predictions"."interval_low_pct" <= "predictions"."interval_high_pct"

pred_probabilities.name: pred_probabilities
pred_probabilities.value: ("predictions"."prob_up" is null and "predictions"."prob_down" is null and "predictions"."prob_neutral" is null) or ("predictions"."prob_up" between 0 and 1 and "predictions"."prob_down" between 0 and 1 and "predictions"."prob_neutral" between 0 and 1 and abs("predictions"."prob_up" + "predictions"."prob_down" + "predictions"."prob_neutral" - 1) <= 0.000001)

pred_abstain_has_no_numbers.name: pred_abstain_has_no_numbers
pred_abstain_has_no_numbers.value: "predictions"."quality_tier" not in ('insufficient', 'direction_only') or ("predictions"."central_move_pct" is null and "predictions"."interval_low_pct" is null and "predictions"."prob_up" is null)
